summary: Alpha Tau Medical Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the successful treatment of the first pancreatic cancer patient in Italy with its Alpha DaRT therapy at the University of Verona's Pancreas Institute. The filing reports a clinical milestone under a feasibility and safety study (Protocol CTP-PANC-03) for locally advanced pancreatic cancer, with no financial terms, board recommendations, or deal mechanics. No special-situation category applies, as this is a routine operational press release, not a corporate transaction. Alpha Tau is the issuer reporting the event. What to watch: continued enrollment and data readouts from the pancreatic cancer program.
